equations.EM_density: rho_Q(x)=-(1/2)*sum_s U_s^dagger U_s+(1/2)*sum_s V_s^dagger V_s, only when U,V are actual Higgs-selected charge -1 Dirac sections and their CAR/antiparticle embedding is bound.
equations.Hamiltonian_vertices: delta Hcan/dA_t=(-i G_c)/N; delta Hcan/dA_i=(-i alpha_i G_c)/R4; delta Hcan/dH_r=M_fixedY(basis_r)
equations.head_on_charge_dipole: For normalized packets centered at z_e=-separation/2 and z_p=+separation/2, integral z*rho_Q=separation; this moment uses only declared centers, not a chosen packet shape.
equations.original_central_radial_sign: X=dot(A_r)-partial_r(A_t)+[A_t,A_r], q=M*k*X. For the radial-only central reduction, the Maxwell A_t Euler term is +partial_r(q), so partial_r(q)=-lepton_material_action_source-other_actual_action_sources. General angular/interface loads remain in the full Gauss equation.
equations.original_material_Gauss_lepton_source: delta S_lepton/dA_t^c = canonical_spatial_density*(1/2)*sum_s[U_s^dagger*(iG_c)*U_s-V_s^dagger*(iG_c)*V_s]; G_c are the ORIGINAL unitTr16 H1,H2,H3,HY matrices. No extra e, trace factor or family multiplicity. N*dHcan/dA_t cancels N once.
equations.packet_energy: Each physical packet must be a section in the selected particle/antiparticle spectral subspace of the same action Dirac Cauchy problem, with central-energy expectation E_beam and the declared opposite incoming momentum/center data.
equations.shared_Gauss: delta S_total/dA_t=delta S_gauge/dA_t+delta S_H/dA_t+delta S_lepton/dA_t=0, including interface normal flux on the actual Cauchy domain.
equations.source_sign: At fixed canonical measure the lepton action variation is -<delta Hcan>; measure/coframe/domain variations must also be included in full metric and event rows.
equations.total_charge: integral rho_Q=0 for normalized particle and antiparticle sections; this does not imply rho_Q(x)=0.
equations.width_separation: Width and separation constrain moments of the supplied sections; these moments do not select their spectral coefficients, phases, polarizations or transverse homogeneous fields.

executable_apis.Gauss_source: original_material_Gauss_source(U,V,canonical_spatial_density,rho,annihilators,normalization_owner,tests=None,quadrature=None) returns all four original material A_t action-cotangent source densities and optionally their actual weak loads. It retains distributed density and supplies no net-charge-to-local-zero substitution.
executable_apis.convention: Pure component current applications may be averaged on a common observable/background. Wick of the mean covariance is rejected by the exact two-current tensor.
executable_apis.current: apply_incoming_packet_current(U,V,canonical_Hamiltonian_vertices,rho,annihilators,metadata) constructs actual operator field, exact current mean and ordered/connected two-current products on supplied physical packet/background maps.
executable_apis.packet: construct_action_packet_sections(F,D,H,R4,Omega,Cu,Cv,Cauchy_quadrature) synthesizes U/V and spatial derivatives from supplied same-action basis coefficients, checks the full Cauchy CAR Gram, and executes original canonical_lepton_hamiltonian_maps for both Dirac proper-time first jets. It supplies no default spectral coefficients.
executable_apis.pairing: validate_action_packet_Cauchy_Gram(U,V,quadrature) enforces the complete represented canonical CAR pairing, with no replacement by point-fiber Gram.

existing_background_routes_checked: The intrinsic lepton constructor consumes actual H, R4, gauge connection, value and spatial-derivative maps; it selects no stationary background.
The raw228 primal operator consumes the earlier common enclosure fields and uses a constant-angular invariant trial subspace, not a localized two-beam spatial eigenbasis.

The v15.38 conformal constraint solver assumes a particular conformal S7 metric, time-symmetric scalar eta/sigma and normalized FR source. Its callable signature has no electron/positron packet or full18 CAR-current operand; its selected branch is not this collider preparation.
The old Higgs stationary branch uses an explicitly non-action-derived universal GeV calibration and does not solve the new common Einstein/gauge/Higgs/matter constraints. It was not imported.

operand_roles.controllable_preparation: Beam energy, width/spread, separation, timing, polarization and explicitly selected packet family describe the preparation; they do not modify BHSM action coefficients.
operand_roles.dynamical_unknowns: The common metric/extrinsic curvature, gauge connection/canonical flux and Higgs/scalar fields respond through the original coupled constraints and evolution. Their sourced residuals cannot be removed by setting the prepared local current to zero.
operand_roles.independent_homogeneous_preparation: Incoming radiative/transverse Cauchy data and boundary/asymptotic preparation remain independent state data until chosen or supplied. They are not automatically a zero exterior.
operand_roles.mathematical_controls: Quadrature, represented basis and numerical tolerances approximate the owned domain and equations; they are not new physical closure terms.
operand_roles.physical_residual: A nonzero sourced Gauss/action residual can be the expected signal of an unevaluated physical current or field variable, or of an incorrect zero-source/background assumption. The finite identities here do not require that physical residual to vanish.

output_scope: Actual retained action vertices and exact finite prepared field/current operators were evaluated. No physical U/V packet section or incoming Maxwell/Higgs/metric Cauchy field was supplied or claimed evaluated.

smallest_actual_missing_input_and_solve.constraint: For that supplied preparation, solve the original coupled Hamiltonian/momentum/gauge constraints with the nonzero local packet gauge/Higgs currents and interface fluxes. Setting every bosonic field to an old vacuum or a zero current from <psi>=0 would violate this source application.
smallest_actual_missing_input_and_solve.preparation: One common collision Cauchy preparation/domain: its background matter/geometry and incoming radiation/asymptotic boundary condition, together with spectral packet coefficients or an explicitly selected experimental packet family. E_beam, width and separation alone fix finitely many moments, not a Cauchy section.
smallest_actual_missing_input_and_solve.spectral: On that same regular geometry/domain, build the full18 Dirac spatial/Cauchy operator and its actual particle/antiparticle subspaces; insert supplied packet coefficients, normalize in the complete action Cauchy Gram, and apply these exported original vertices.
smallest_actual_missing_input_and_solve.unselected_freedom: Even for fixed packet charge, Gauss constrains the divergence/longitudinal momentum and its boundary flux. It does not select transverse homogeneous/radiative Cauchy data; they belong to the external preparation. No such fields were set to zero.
